snippet.title: Malasombra - Live Action Teaser
snippet.description:
MALASOMBRA - New Action Adventure Video Game for the NES.

We Are in Kickstarter!
https://kickstarter.com/projects/malasombra-nes-game/malasombra-new-action-adventure-video-game-for-the-nes

Malasombra is a new video game developed by the 4MHz team for NES consoles. Set in legends and fairy tales, it poses an epic adventure with an exciting story where nothing is what it seems. An ambitious project carefully designed to be published on digital media and cartridge.

Don't miss early Bird Offers! Go to Kickstarter and click on NOTIFY ME button now :)

https://kickstarter.com/projects/malasombra-nes-game/malasombra-new-action-adventure-video-game-for-the-nes


More info:
4MHz Website: https://www.4mhz.es/en/
X (English): https://x.com/4mhz_en
X (Spanish): https://x.com/4mhz_es
BlueSky: https://4mhzes.bsky.social/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/4mhz.es

Malasombra - a new homebrew video game for NES
